history.contentIn: The chemtrail conspiracy theory claims that long-lasting condensation trails behind high-flying aircraft are chemical or biological spraying for weather control, solar radiation management, or other hidden purposes. The scientific consensus is that this is false: persistent trails are ordinary contrails made of ice crystals that linger under certain humidity and temperature conditions. There is no evidence that purported chemtrails differ from normal water-based contrails. Debnath, Reiner, Sovacool and colleagues (iScience, 2023) analyzed 814,924 English-language tweets containing #geoengineering from 2009 to 2021.
